name: page-head
title: Page head
description: The page's H1 set like the homepage statement: one size in two tones, the lead in white running on into the rest in mid, centered in a 64rem measure, with a plate and a quiet button under it.
use_for: The top of an inner page: contact, careers, articles, a case study.
never: A second size or a bold word for emphasis: color does the work
An eyebrow or a label over it
source: components/page-head.tsx (pt-[128px] sm:pt-[176px], pb-16 sm:pb-24, max-w-[64rem], text-lg leading-[1.14], text-white then text-mid; actions mt-10 sm:mt-12 gap-2).

<!-- The contact page's head: the lead in white, the rest in mid, a plate button and a quiet one. -->
<agd-page-head head-id="contact" lead="Tell us what you're building." rest="Acme partners with startups to design, build, and ship software. The quickest way to start is a call or an email.">
  <agd-button href="#">Book a free strategy call</agd-button>
  <agd-button href="#" variant="secondary">hello@acme.com</agd-button>
</agd-page-head>
